description: Machine-readable source of truth for stable GitLab workflow snippet transport contracts. The human-readable Markdown table in gitlab/reference/snippet-transports.md is checked against this metadata.

via_evidence_requirement.summary: Reports that rely on GitLab API transport evidence must state via=mcp for MCP primary transport or via=glab-fallback for guarded fallback/helper transport; via=n/a is reserved for no-action handoffs.

mutation_guard.applies_to: all snippets with non-empty allowed_mutations; read-only snippets feed decision-grade evidence into the guard before later mutations

snippets.name: local-repo-preflight
required_guards: project binding must match the remote URL-derived project path
local default ref must exist and be current
fallback_conditions: glab repo view only when MCP is unavailable during bootstrap
glab repo view for flag or JSON troubleshooting after help-first verification

post_mutation_reread.expectation: N/A — read-only.

via_evidence.requirement: Record the transport used when preflight evidence is reported.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: `get_project`; local `git` for cwd, remote URL, branch/ref state.
markdown.inputs: Current worktree, remote URL-derived project path.
markdown.outputs: Verified project path, repo URLs, default branch, local repo root.
markdown.required_guards: Stop on non-git cwd, project mismatch, missing default branch, stale/missing local default ref, or auth failure.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `glab repo view` only when MCP is unavailable during bootstrap or for flag/JSON troubleshooting; run help-first first.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: N/A — read-only.

snippets.name: issue-pickup
required_guards: list results are candidate data unless narrowly scoped
maintenance mutations require an owning workflow step
fallback_conditions: glab issue list/view when MCP list pagination blocks selection
glab issue list/view when MCP read is unavailable
exact glab help must be verified first

post_mutation_reread.expectation: N/A for reads; after issue update/close fallback, re-read `get_issue`.

via_evidence.requirement: Record the transport used for issue pickup evidence and any maintenance mutation.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: `list_issues`, `get_issue`, issue notes/list discussions tool when comments are required.
markdown.inputs: Issue IID/URL or selection filters (target repo AFK-ready label from `project_profile.label_profile_ref`, assignee, state); project path.
markdown.outputs: Issue IID/title/state/labels/assignees/URL/description and comments.
markdown.required_guards: Treat list results as candidate data; do not assume exhaustive lists when a list page may be truncated. Stop on confidential/blocked/wrong-project ambiguity.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `glab issue list/view` fallback when MCP list pagination gap blocks selection or MCP read is unavailable; use exact help.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: N/A for reads; after issue update/close fallback, re-read `get_issue`.

snippets.name: draft-mr-create
required_guards: target branch must be server default or explicit policy target
fallback_conditions: file-backed draft_mr_create helper when MCP create is unavailable
file-backed draft_mr_create helper when safe-text wrapper is required by runtime

post_mutation_reread.expectation: Required: `get_merge_request` and verify draft=true, source/target, description present, and head SHA.

via_evidence.requirement: Record via=mcp or via=glab-fallback for the MR create mutation.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: `create_merge_request`, then `get_merge_request`.
markdown.inputs: Project path, source branch, target branch, title, validated description, draft=true, `Closes #<iid>`.
markdown.outputs: Draft MR IID/URL/source/target/head/draft state.
markdown.required_guards: Source branch must exist remotely; description passes content-byte guard; target branch is server default or explicit policy target.
markdown.fallback_conditions: File-backed `draft_mr_create` helper only when MCP create is unavailable or the helper's safe-text wrapper is required by runtime.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: Required: `get_merge_request` and verify draft=true, source/target, description present, and head SHA.

snippets.name: mr-description-update
required_guards: do not combine ready unless workflow chooses mark-ready path
fallback_conditions: file-backed mr_description_update helper when MCP update is unavailable
file-backed mr_description_update helper when helper body validation is required

post_mutation_reread.expectation: Required: verify description changed and MR head still equals expected/reviewed SHA when one is in force.

via_evidence.requirement: Record via=mcp or via=glab-fallback for the description update mutation.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: `update_merge_request(description=...)`, then `get_merge_request`.
markdown.inputs: Bound MR IID/URL, project path, validated description.
markdown.outputs: Updated MR description with unchanged draft/ready state.
markdown.required_guards: Bound MR/project must match; description passes content-byte guard; do not combine ready unless the workflow explicitly chooses the mark-ready path.
markdown.fallback_conditions: File-backed `mr_description_update` helper when MCP update is unavailable or helper body validation is required.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: Required: verify description changed and MR head still equals expected/reviewed SHA when one is in force.

snippets.name: draft-mr-mark-ready
required_guards: local gate must be PASS or N/A
parent-owned Gate Receipt must pass when parent owns ready transition
fallback_conditions: glab mr update --ready only when MCP update is unavailable
fresh MCP read before and after fallback

post_mutation_reread.expectation: Required: verify `draft=false`, description intact, and head SHA still equals reviewed SHA.

via_evidence.requirement: Record via=mcp or via=glab-fallback for the ready-state mutation.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: `update_merge_request(draft=false)`, optionally same call with final `description`, then `get_merge_request`.
markdown.inputs: Bound MR IID, expected head SHA, final Reviewer Lift, local-gate or parent Gate Receipt evidence.
markdown.outputs: MR draft=false/ready state for the same head SHA.
markdown.required_guards: Local gate must be PASS/N/A, or parent-owned Gate Receipt must pass; never ready a stale head or empty description.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `glab mr update --ready` only when MCP update is unavailable; run fresh MCP read before fallback and after fallback.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: Required: verify `draft=false`, description intact, and head SHA still equals reviewed SHA.

snippets.name: mr-pickup
required_guards: do not approve or finish from list-only data
fallback_conditions: glab mr view/list when MCP read is unavailable
glab mr view/list when list pagination blocks selection
help-first verification

post_mutation_reread.expectation: N/A — read-only.

via_evidence.requirement: Record the transport used when MR pickup evidence is reported.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: `get_merge_request`; `list_merge_requests` only for candidate selection; MR notes/discussions tool for comments.
markdown.inputs: MR IID/full URL/current branch filters, project path.
markdown.outputs: Decision-grade MR metadata: IID, state, draft, branches, author id, URL, head SHA, pipeline, merge status.
markdown.required_guards: Do not approve/finish from list-only data; bind host/project/path before action.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `glab mr view/list` fallback when MCP read is unavailable or list pagination gap blocks selection; help-first.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: N/A — read-only.

snippets.name: artifact-capture
required_guards: stop on unredacted sensitive body risk
fallback_conditions: glab mr diff/view when MCP diff endpoint is unavailable
glab mr diff/view for numstat helper compatibility

post_mutation_reread.expectation: N/A — read-only.

via_evidence.requirement: Record the transport used when artifact-capture evidence is reported.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: `get_merge_request`, MR diff/changes MCP tool, MR notes/discussions tool.
markdown.inputs: Bound MR IID, project path, run directory.
markdown.outputs: Redacted local MR metadata/comments/diff/numstat artifacts.
markdown.required_guards: Stop on diff unavailable, wrong project, stale metadata, or unredacted sensitive body risk.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `glab mr diff/view` fallback when MCP diff endpoint is unavailable or for numstat helper compatibility.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: N/A — read-only.

snippets.name: ci-decision-snapshot
required_guards: green counts only when pipeline SHA equals reviewed SHA
missing CI is not approval evidence
red CI is not approval evidence
stale CI is not approval evidence
skipped or canceled CI is not approval evidence
fallback_conditions: glab ci status --branch fallback only when MCP pipeline read is unavailable
MR .pipeline fallback only when MCP pipeline read is unavailable
never use whole-MR CI without SHA

post_mutation_reread.expectation: N/A — read-only.

via_evidence.requirement: Record the transport used when CI snapshot evidence is reported.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: `get_merge_request`, `list_pipelines(sha=reviewed_sha)` or `get_pipeline`.
markdown.inputs: Bound MR IID, source branch, reviewed/candidate SHA.
markdown.outputs: MR head SHA, pipeline id/url/status/sha, merge status.
markdown.required_guards: Green counts only when pipeline SHA equals reviewed SHA; missing/red/stale/skipped/canceled is not approval evidence.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `glab ci status --branch` / MR `.pipeline` fallback only when MCP pipeline read is unavailable; never use whole-MR CI without SHA.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: N/A — read-only.

snippets.name: ci-watch-sha-pinned
required_guards: every poll fails closed if MR head differs from reviewed SHA
every poll fails closed when pipeline SHA is stale
every poll fails closed when pipeline is red, canceled, skipped, missing past timeout
fallback_conditions: gitlab-ci-watch.sh helper when MCP polling is unavailable
help-first glab fallback when MCP polling is unavailable
helper must preserve exact-SHA rules

post_mutation_reread.expectation: N/A — read-only.

via_evidence.requirement: Record the transport used when CI watch evidence is reported.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: Repeated `get_merge_request` plus exact-SHA `list_pipelines`/`get_pipeline`.
markdown.inputs: MR IID, source branch for progress/fallback only, reviewed SHA, timeout, poll interval.
markdown.outputs: Human or machine CI verdict with observed SHA, pipeline id/url/status, stale/timeout blockers.
markdown.required_guards: Every poll fails closed if MR head differs from reviewed SHA or pipeline SHA is stale/red/canceled/skipped/missing past timeout.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `gitlab-ci-watch.sh` helper / help-first `glab` fallback when MCP polling is unavailable; helper must preserve exact-SHA rules.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: N/A — read-only.

snippets.name: mr-note-create
required_guards: Review Report/status-comment MR notes must be non-resolvable
never post Review Reports issue notes
fallback_conditions: mr_note_create helper when MCP note creation is unavailable
mr_note_create helper when file-backed validation is needed

post_mutation_reread.expectation: Required: re-read MR notes/discussions verify note exists and, for Review Reports, body matches source before approval/finish, without printing body.

via_evidence.requirement: Record via=mcp or via=glab-fallback for the MR note mutation.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: MR note/comment creation tool (`create_note` scoped merge request), then MR notes/discussions read.
markdown.inputs: Bound MR IID, project path, validated report body.
markdown.outputs: One non-resolvable MR note on bound MR.
markdown.required_guards: Body passes content-byte guard; Review Report/status-comment MR notes must be non-resolvable; never post Review Reports issue notes; project binding must be explicit.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `mr_note_create` helper when MCP note creation is unavailable or file-backed non-resolvable validation is needed.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: Required: re-read MR notes/discussions verify note exists and, for Review Reports, body matches source before approval/finish without printing body.

snippets.name: issue-note-create
required_guards: never use for MR action reports
fallback_conditions: issue_note_create helper when MCP issue-note creation is unavailable
issue_note_create helper when file-backed validation is needed

post_mutation_reread.expectation: Required: re-read issue notes and verify a note exists without printing the body.

via_evidence.requirement: Record via=mcp or via=glab-fallback for the issue note mutation.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: Issue note/comment creation tool (`create_issue_note` or issue-scoped `create_note`), then issue notes read.
markdown.inputs: Bound issue IID, project path, validated comment body.
markdown.outputs: One issue note on the bound issue.
markdown.required_guards: Body passes content-byte guard; never use for Review Reports or MR action reports.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `issue_note_create` helper when MCP issue-note creation is unavailable or file-backed validation is needed.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: Required: re-read issue notes and verify a note exists without printing the body.

snippets.name: label-reconcile
required_guards: reject final state/category conflicts before mutation
fallback_conditions: label_reconcile helper when MCP label semantics are unavailable
label_reconcile helper when label conflict helper is needed

post_mutation_reread.expectation: Required: `get_issue` final labels match requested reconcile result.

via_evidence.requirement: Record via=mcp or via=glab-fallback for the label mutation.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: Issue label update tool (`update_issue` label add/remove semantics), then `get_issue`.
markdown.inputs: Issue IID, add labels, remove labels, allowed state/category label sets.
markdown.outputs: Final issue labels.
markdown.required_guards: Reject add/remove overlap and final state/category conflicts before mutation.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `label_reconcile` helper when MCP label semantics are unavailable or label conflict helper is needed.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: Required: `get_issue` final labels match requested reconcile result.

snippets.name: safe-mr-json
fallback_conditions: safe_mr_json helper when MCP read is unavailable
safe_mr_json helper when wrapper validation is required

post_mutation_reread.expectation: N/A — read-only.

via_evidence.requirement: Record the transport used when safe MR JSON evidence is reported.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: `get_merge_request` plus project read; no list-only data.
markdown.inputs: MR IID, project path, repo URL/project binding.
markdown.outputs: Decision-grade MR JSON-equivalent metadata.
markdown.required_guards: Fail on project binding, SHA, pipeline, merge-status, branch, JSON/control-char drift.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `safe_mr_json` helper when MCP read is unavailable, when wrapper validation is required, or as the bounded fallback for repeated SHA/state guard re-reads where the MCP read returns full bodies (slim guard-read path).
markdown.post_mutation_reread: N/A — read-only.

snippets.name: auto-merge-api-fallback
required_guards: fresh MCP re-read of SHA before action
fallback_conditions: only the known glab mr merge --auto-merge 405 path for authorized non-builders
preserve SHA/CI/authority guards

post_mutation_reread.expectation: Required: re-read MR and record `via=mcp` or `via=glab-fallback`.

via_evidence.requirement: Record via=mcp or via=glab-fallback for the auto-merge queue mutation.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: Prefer `merge_merge_request(auto_merge=true, sha=reviewed_sha, should_remove_source_branch=true, confirm=true)`, then `get_merge_request`.
markdown.inputs: Bound MR, reviewed SHA, source/target branches, queue authority/source, caller role/identity.
markdown.outputs: Auto-merge queued or blocked handoff.
markdown.required_guards: Fresh MCP re-read of SHA, exact-SHA CI/protected policy, authority/source, caller identity/token-stability, and context-firewall eligibility before action.
markdown.fallback_conditions: Only the known `glab mr merge --auto-merge` 405 path for authorized non-builders; preserve SHA/CI/authority guards.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: Required: re-read MR and record `via=mcp` or `via=glab-fallback`.

snippets.name: sha-guard
required_guards: any head SHA mismatch is stale review
fallback_conditions: glab mr view only when MCP read unavailable
bind explicit repo/full URL

post_mutation_reread.expectation: N/A — read-only.

via_evidence.requirement: Record the transport used when SHA guard evidence is reported.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: `get_merge_request`.
markdown.inputs: Bound MR IID/URL, reviewed SHA.
markdown.outputs: Pass/fail head SHA equality; repeated guards read only `sha`/`draft`/`state`/`detailedMergeStatus` per the slim guard-read path, keeping the first per-MR full read unchanged.
markdown.required_guards: Any mismatch is stale review; no approval/merge/queue.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `glab mr view` fallback only when MCP read unavailable; still bind explicit repo/full URL.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: N/A — read-only.

snippets.name: sha-bound-approval
required_guards: fresh MCP re-read of MR head before action
fallback_conditions: glab mr approve --sha only when MCP approval unavailable
help-first verification
same guards as MCP

post_mutation_reread.expectation: Required: re-read approval state/MR and record `via=mcp` or `via=glab-fallback`.

via_evidence.requirement: Record via=mcp or via=glab-fallback for the approval mutation.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: `approve_merge_request(sha=reviewed_sha, confirm=true)`, then approval state/MR read.
markdown.inputs: Bound MR, reviewed SHA, approval authority/source, caller identity.
markdown.outputs: Approval for reviewed SHA or blocked action result.
markdown.required_guards: Fresh MCP re-read of MR head, approval authority, caller identity/token-stability, context-firewall eligibility, and exact target before action.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `glab mr approve --sha` only when MCP approval unavailable; help-first and same guards.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: Required: re-read approval state/MR and record `via=mcp` or `via=glab-fallback`.

snippets.name: sha-bound-merge
required_guards: fresh MCP re-read of head SHA before action
fallback_conditions: glab mr merge --sha --auto-merge=false only for documented MCP merge robustness gap
glab mr merge --sha --auto-merge=false when MCP unavailable
do not fallback on stale/red/missing/authority uncertainty

post_mutation_reread.expectation: Required: re-read MR; classify merged/already_merged/stale_head/merge_blocked; record `via=...`.

via_evidence.requirement: Record via=mcp or via=glab-fallback for the merge mutation.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: `merge_merge_request(sha=reviewed_sha, confirm=true, auto_merge=false)`, then `get_merge_request`.
markdown.inputs: Bound MR, reviewed SHA, exact-SHA green CI, direct-merge authority/source, caller identity.
markdown.outputs: Direct merge result or blocked handoff.
markdown.required_guards: Fresh MCP re-read of head SHA, exact-SHA CI, merge authority/source, caller identity/token-stability, context-firewall eligibility, and project binding before action.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `glab mr merge --sha --auto-merge=false` only for documented MCP merge robustness gap or MCP unavailable; do not fallback on stale/red/missing/authority uncertainty.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: Required: re-read MR; classify merged/already_merged/stale_head/merge_blocked; record `via=...`.

snippets.name: sha-bound-auto-merge-queue
required_guards: fresh MCP re-read of head before action
exact-SHA pending/green protected policy before action
fallback_conditions: glab mr merge --auto-merge --sha only for documented MCP/CLI 405 gap after all guards
auto_merge_api_fallback only for documented MCP/CLI 405 gap after all guards

post_mutation_reread.expectation: Required: re-read MR; record queue state and `via=...`.

via_evidence.requirement: Record via=mcp or via=glab-fallback for the auto-merge queue mutation.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: `merge_merge_request(sha=reviewed_sha, confirm=true, auto_merge=true, should_remove_source_branch=true)`, then `get_merge_request`.
markdown.inputs: Bound MR, reviewed SHA, protected auto-merge policy, queue authority/source, caller identity.
markdown.outputs: Auto-merge queued or blocked handoff.
markdown.required_guards: Fresh MCP re-read of head, exact-SHA pending/green protected policy, queue authority/source, caller identity/token-stability, and context-firewall eligibility.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `glab mr merge --auto-merge --sha --remove-source-branch` or `auto_merge_api_fallback` only for documented MCP/CLI 405 gap after all guards.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: Required: re-read MR; record queue state and `via=...`.

snippets.name: approval-confirmation
required_guards: do not claim approval from laggy MR metadata alone
fallback_conditions: glab api approvals fallback when MCP approval-state read unavailable

post_mutation_reread.expectation: N/A — read-only confirmation.

via_evidence.requirement: Record the transport used when approval confirmation evidence is reported.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: Approval state tool (`get_merge_request_approval` / `approval_state`) plus `get_merge_request`.
markdown.inputs: Bound MR IID/project path, approved/reviewed SHA.
markdown.outputs: Approval record tied to MR and caller.
markdown.required_guards: Do not claim approval from laggy MR metadata alone; stop if endpoint/read unavailable.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `glab api .../approvals` fallback when MCP approval-state read unavailable.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: N/A — read-only confirmation.

snippets.name: finish-mr-authority-aware
fallback_conditions: gitlab-finish-mr.sh helper only when its guarded fallback model exactly fits
raw glab fallback only under snippet-specific conditions after MCP re-read

post_mutation_reread.expectation: Required after any mutation: re-read MR; verify state/issue/branch cleanup; record `via=...`.

via_evidence.requirement: Record via=mcp or via=glab-fallback for any finish mutation; via=n/a is allowed only for no-action handoff/held results.

markdown.mcp_primary_tools: Fresh `get_merge_request`, exact-SHA pipeline read, caller identity read, authority matrix helper, then one of approval/merge/auto-merge MCP actions as authorized.
markdown.inputs: MR IID, reviewed SHA, merge authority/source, caller role/id, source/target branch, default branch, optional issue/worktree.
markdown.outputs: `finish_result`/handoff with action, blocker, sha, CI, issue, cleanup, identity, and `via`.
markdown.required_guards: Builder always stops at handoff; stop on stale head, stale/red/missing CI, missing authority/source, identity drift, same-session review/finish, unsupported action, dirty worktree cleanup.
markdown.fallback_conditions: `gitlab-finish-mr.sh` helper only when its guarded fallback model exactly fits; raw `glab` fallback only under snippet-specific conditions after MCP re-read.
markdown.post_mutation_reread: Required after any mutation: re-read MR; verify state/issue/branch cleanup; record `via=...`.
